<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex35032024-10-2316-31-44" status="finalized" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><milestone unit="section" n=" Colophon (123b8-10) (p. 428:8-10)"/>
        <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4714">so so thar pa'i rnam bshad yid sbyin nor bu'i them skas</rs> zhes bya ba | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">bla ma</rs>'i gsung dang <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:7338">'grel pa</rs> la <abbr>brten nas</abbr> thub <abbr>pa'i</abbr> gsung dpang por byas pas 'jug ldog la mi 'khrul ba | <hi rendition="#Time">sa <choice><sic>po</sic><corr>pho</corr></choice> sbrul gyi lo<anchor xml:id="a1"/></hi> la <note type="editorial">If the author is bDud rtsi grags (ID: 3880) this year should be 1209/10 when he was about 57 years of age.</note> ¦ <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3880">shag kya'i dge slong bdud rtsi grags</rs> gyis sbyar <lb n="123b9"/> ba || rdzogs s+ho|| bkra shis so ||</seg></TEI>
